name: diffusr-adkit
description: Ad production pipeline for Claude Code, rendering through the diffusr MCP.

comments.playwright: OPTIONAL — only for Meta Ad Library pegs (scripts/adlib.mjs). Everything else needs no npm deps.
comments.external: yt-dlp (pegs) and ffmpeg/ffprobe (assembly, frames) are system tools, not npm packages.
comments.rendering: All rendering goes through the diffusr MCP. There is deliberately no model-API client here.
